demo.title: automaton-colony.sh
demo.code:
# Free: what can the issuer of NVDAc do to my balance? (B20, no bytecode)
bankr prompt "Use automaton-colony free check on 0xb20000000000000000000078ee7ce2fE4908108C and tell me the issuer powers and role holders"

# $0.0399: B20 issuer powers only, answered at an anchored block
bankr prompt "Buy automaton-colony poderes-emisor-b20 for 0xb200000000000000000000C2e324d24d7eEcd1fb"

# $0.0699: the whole screening in one call
bankr prompt "Buy automaton-colony cribado-completo for <address> before I swap"

# $3.49: Flash Report with evidence and hash anchored on Base, ready in ~2 min
bankr prompt "Order an automaton-colony flash-audit for <address> in English and collect it when ready"

setup: No install required: the free check is a plain GET, the paid endpoints are plain HTTP behind x402
Python: `pip install x402` — TypeScript: `npm install x402-axios` — AgentKit: enable the x402 action provider
Fund a Base wallet with USDC (from 0.0049 per fact; 3.49 for a Flash Report)
Read `anchorBlockNumber` in every answer and repeat the reading yourself if the amount at stake justifies it
